description_for_human: Inspect, validate, document, and diagnose Kore.ai ABL agents without changing platform state.
description_for_model: Use this plugin as the arch-copilot-readonly capability profile for Kore.ai ABL engineering. Use only the listed functions for verified inspection, package validation, documentation, and runtime diagnosis. This profile cannot create, update, delete, publish, deploy, approve, cancel, or otherwise mutate platform state or execute agent workflows. Use MCP results for live platform evidence, WebSearch for public documentation, CodeInterpreter for user-provided files, and EmbeddedKnowledge for bundled guidance. Never request or expose credentials, invent IDs or results, or claim completion without evidence.

functions.name: debug_list_agents
functions.description: List available ABL agents in the authenticated workspace. Read-only; use when agent scope is unknown. Results are paginated.

functions.name: debug_traces
functions.description: Search bounded live or historical Runtime traces. Use live evidence for active sessions and historical evidence with projectId and sessionId after a session ends. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_session_history
functions.description: List historical Runtime sessions or read persisted trace pages. Use when live buffers are unavailable or historical analysis is requested. Read-only and paginated.

functions.name: debug_get_current_state
functions.description: Read current or historical agent state, including flow state, gathered fields, and context. Require session scope for historical reads. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_get_span_tree
functions.description: Read the execution span tree for an agent session. Use it to understand step and tool timing; choose historical source for ended sessions. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_get_errors
functions.description: Find errors, warnings, escalations, constraint failures, and tool failures for an agent session. Return bounded Runtime evidence. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_explain_decision
functions.description: Explain one Runtime decision with surrounding evidence. Use after identifying a decision event; do not infer a cause without supporting traces. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_get_flow_graph
functions.description: Show the execution graph for a scripted, reasoning, or supervisor agent. Choose JSON for analysis or Mermaid for documentation. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_list_active_sessions
functions.description: List active agent sessions available for live diagnosis. Use historical session history for ended sessions. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_docs
functions.description: Search or read authoritative ABL documentation. Provide a topic for a page, a query for search, or neither to list available topics. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_analyze_session
functions.description: Analyze one agent session for duration, LLM calls, state, loops, errors, constraints, and tool failures. Use historical source with projectId and sessionId after the session ends. Read-only.

functions.name: platform_validate_package
functions.description: Validate an ABL package or project folder using compiler and design diagnostics. Read-only; return blockers, warnings, and file or line evidence.

functions.name: platform_package_model
functions.description: Show the compiler-visible model of an ABL package, including agents, tools, handoffs, memory, flows, and unresolved references. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_lint_abl
functions.description: Run ABL design and repair lint checks for empty responses, incomplete finalization, undeclared variables, side-effect chains, and tool or text risks. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_why_transcript_failed
functions.description: Correlate a failed transcript with ABL package and file or line evidence. Use this as the canonical transcript-diagnosis function when available. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_diagnose_transcript
functions.description: Compatibility alias for transcript diagnosis. Prefer debug_why_transcript_failed when both functions are available. Read-only.

functions.name: debug_diagnose
functions.description: Run read-only diagnostic analysis for an agent or session. Provide an exact agentName or sessionId; configOnly is useful for configuration-only inspection.
